component.name: SlattyLauncher
component.summary: Install and play your GOG games

description.p: A native GOG launcher for Linux. It signs in to your GOG account, shows your library, installs Windows games from GOG's Galaxy content system and native Linux games from GOG's installers, runs them through umu and Proton, keeps cloud saves in sync and reports achievements to GOG, without the official client.

ul.li: Windows games run isolated from your files by default
Cloud saves that never overwrite a save without a copy
Verify, repair, update, DLC and language changes

description.p: SlattyLauncher is not affiliated with GOG.
